properties.name: Celaena Sardothien
properties.content: Adarlan's most notorious assassin, released from Endovier to compete as a champion.
properties.summary: Central entity connecting imprisonment, court survival, friendship, hidden magic, and the final duel.

properties.name: Chaol Westfall
properties.content: Captain of the Royal Guard and Celaena's escort, trainer, and eventual protector.
properties.summary: Relational anchor for the trust-through-discipline pattern.

properties.name: Dorian Havilliard
properties.content: Crown Prince of Adarlan who recruits Celaena and keeps bringing her deeper into court life.
properties.summary: Catalyst for the initial bargain and a recurring force around knowledge, freedom, and attraction.

properties.name: Nehemia Ytger
properties.content: Princess of Eyllwe whose friendship and politics transform Celaena's view of the court.
properties.summary: Bridge between personal trust and anti-imperial strategy.

properties.name: King of Adarlan
properties.content: Conqueror whose court, competition, and anti-magic regime define the story's pressure system.
properties.summary: The political center of gravity around which the champion system operates.

properties.name: Duke Perrington
properties.content: Council power broker who sponsors Cain and becomes a focal point for suspicion around dark influence.
properties.summary: Concentrates the corruption arc around one visible court actor.

properties.name: Cain
properties.content: Brutal champion backed by Perrington who becomes visibly tied to dark power before his death.
properties.summary: Main rival in the competition and key signal for the corruption pattern.

properties.name: Elena
properties.content: Ancient queen who warns Celaena and intervenes during the final duel.
properties.summary: Mythic agent linking hidden symbols to concrete survival.

properties.name: Endovier
properties.content: Salt-mine prison that defines Celaena's initial status and the stakes of every later status shift.
properties.summary: Location node anchoring the first fact supersession chain.

properties.name: Glass Castle
properties.content: Court setting that contains the competition, the library, the clock tower, and the final duel.
properties.summary: Primary stage for the semantic and temporal convergence of the graph.

properties.name: Eyllwe
properties.content: Nehemia's homeland and the moral counterweight to Adarlan's empire.
properties.summary: Geopolitical node that widens the graph beyond the castle walls.

properties.name: Wyrdmarks
properties.content: Forbidden symbols and magical traces that recur around the clock tower, Elena, Cain, and the final duel.
properties.summary: Concept node for the hidden-magic storyline and its higher-order principle.
